cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Relationship Ledger
cards.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've ticked my opening invitation like you did. Two yeses. Come along and I'll forgive our argument.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ticked yours because I'd checked the address. I work that night.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, address checked. You know where to bring the apology, then. Could you help hang the paintings instead?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can hang them on Sunday. I can't stay all day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hanging gets you forgiven. Stay for tea and I won't retell the argument to Mum.
